title: 潜在推理自解释框架：在潜在空间中思考，用语言解释
summary: SELR框架训练单一模型同时优化答案损失和思维链损失，使潜在推理既高效又可解释，无需外部解码器，在LLM和VLM上验证了优越的token效率和准确性。
summary_en: SELR trains a single model with answer and CoT losses to make latent reasoning efficient and inherently explainable, eliminating external decoders, validated on LLMs and VLMs.
